controls_audited.name: Server-Side Ground Truth Suppression
controls_audited.verification: GET /api/incidents/{id}?blind_review=true purges historical resolution, closure comments, and ground_truth object from JSON responses.

controls_audited.name: Server-Side AI Verdict Masking
controls_audited.verification: safe_ai_verdict is set to null in unsubmitted blind review responses. No AI predictions are serialized.

controls_audited.name: Prompt Injection Mitigation
controls_audited.verification: Raw logs containing closing XML tags are sanitized to HTML entities (</UNTRUSTED_INCIDENT_DATA>).

controls_audited.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation
controls_audited.verification: Fail-closed check enforces tenant boundaries. Default/Platform Admins access global evaluation population; tenant analysts restricted to tenant scope.

controls_audited.name: Immutable Review Audit Trail
controls_audited.verification: AnalystVerdictReview persists reviewer_id, UTC timestamp, review_version, and ground_truth_status without overwriting historical records.
